items.prompt: Why is returning string_view into an ordinary local string unsafe?

options.text: The view automatically deep-copies all characters
options.why: It does not own or copy that character storage.

options.text: Returning any value type is forbidden in C++
options.why: Owning value results are normal and useful.

options.text: The owner dies, leaving a borrowed view without live storage
options.why: Return an owning result or prove an adequate source lifetime.

options.text: Every reference binding permanently extends every target
options.why: Lifetime extension is context-specific and does not save an ordinary local.

items.explanation: A view copied/returned by value is still a nonowning observer.
